categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Has the macOS label and resolves a platform-specific runtime failure where select() rejects timeouts exceeding 10^8 seconds on macOS and BSD.
categories.rationale: Fixes a platform-specific runtime failure on macOS where bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately with 'Could not connect to the server'. While it resolves a supported-platform regression introduced in #34342, it affects only a specific CLI flag rather than overall ability to build or run on the platform.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies Sock::WaitMany in src/util/sock.cpp.
categories.rationale: Corrects socket timeout handling in Sock::WaitMany by capping timeouts to INT_MAX milliseconds. This prevents extremely large timeouts from triggering EINVAL errors from the operating system when zero timeout is requested.
